scripts.seed: SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY=$(npx supabase status -o json | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["SECRET_KEY"])') node --experimental-strip-types packages/crawler/src/seed.ts
scripts.align: cd packages/aligner && SB_KEY=$(npx supabase status -o json | python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['SECRET_KEY'])") uv run python write_timings.py
scripts.scan: cd packages/aligner && SB_KEY=$(npx supabase status -o json | python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['SECRET_KEY'])") uv run python scan_track.py --from-queue
scripts.seed:artists: SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY=$(npx supabase status -o json | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["SECRET_KEY"])') node --experimental-strip-types packages/crawler/src/seed-artists.ts
